items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: So finally, I said okay, and I directed the show and she'd play and her husband was the drummer, and the Nicholas Brothers were in the show.

ctx.x: So finally, I said okay, and I directed the show and she'd play and her husband was the drummer, and the Nicholas Brothers were in the show. And they were terrific.
Nicholas Brothers? Let's see, I can't recall their names right now.
